system.description:
Skill: Chakra Control

Exploit Type: Combat Exploit

You attempt to recover chakra for yourself after striking. When you deal Lethal Attack damage, you may choose to forgo up to 2 Lethal Attack dice. After damage is dealt, roll the number of Lethal Attack dice you forwent. You gain temporary Chakra equal to the highest rolled result. You can only gain the benefit of this Exploit once every 10 minutes, and while in combat with a hostile creature.
